title: amAMM manager can capture fees from the protocol and referrers
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The amAMM manager is allowed to set and adjust swap fees to maximize revenue. A percentage of the fees captured by the manager is distributed to the protocol and referrers.  However, the manager can retain all the fees by acting as a proxy between the swapper and the Bunni protocol. By setting the swap fee in the Bunni protocol to the maximum and offering a lower fee in swaps executed through his proxy contract, users might be incentivized to always interact with the manager contract.
